parsed.rationale: Both `WXYCBackground.wxycBackgroundDark` (BackgroundGradient.swift:30) and `WXYCGradient.wxycBackgroundDark` (WXYCGradient.swift:31) are exact-duplicate computed properties living in the same package (WXUI). Neither is test, codegen, mock, or sample-app code. The duplication is almost certainly accidental — the same dark-background gradient value was defined independently on two different types. The cleanest Swift fix is to extract the shared value into a single location (e.g., a dedicated extension file or a shared constant in WXUI) and have both `WXYCBackground` and `WXYCGradient` reference it, eliminating the redundant definition.
